title: Twenty-eighth social wave Reddit, YouTube, and blog outreach preflight

claims.text: The social outreach packet is prepared-only and does not claim that any Reddit, YouTube, Hacker News, or dev.to comment was posted.
claims.falsification: The packet marks any comment as posted, omits the prepared-only boundary, or lacks an action-time confirmation requirement for public posting.

claims.text: The packet contains 20 exact comment drafts split across 6 Reddit, 8 YouTube, and 6 blog/social targets, with no missing exact-text blocks.
claims.falsification: The packet contains a different total, a different platform split, or any target without an exact text block.

claims.text: The packet limits direct links in exact comment text to R97, the r/MachineLearning self-promotion draft where a repository link is contextually allowed after rule confirmation.
claims.falsification: Any exact comment text outside R97 contains a direct Project Telos repository link or another URL.

claims.text: The packet includes live Reddit voice calibration from the public u/MeAndClaudeMakeHeat comments and leads with adoption, ambition, engine/OS, research, learning, and cross-domain capability rather than receipts alone.
claims.falsification: The packet lacks the live Reddit voice calibration section or frames receipts/proof as the sole adoption reason.

claims.text: The packet cites the current Project Telos outreach-relevant tool surface as Telos 0.2.0 with the 69-tool five-flagship manifest and current Index/Forum/Gather/Crucible versions.
claims.falsification: The packet cites stale Telos, Index, Forum, Gather, or Crucible versions, or omits the 69-tool five-flagship surface.
